revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.what: What the regions are forecast to sell over the next 12 months.

gp.title: Gross profit
gp.what: Revenue less the direct costs of delivering it.
gp.formula: Sum of every region's gross profit

margin.title: Margin
margin.what: How much of each £1 of revenue is left after direct costs.

region.title: Region revenue
region.what: One region's revenue: last year's sales grown by the region's growth rate.
